lines:
flowchart TD
A["Read embedded BuildProvenanceV1 and OS installation observations"] --> B{"Build origin?"}
B -- "PackagedDistribution" --> U1["Unsupported before approval and quiescence: export candidate and update manually"]
B -- "Unknown or Conflicting" --> U2["Unsupported before approval and quiescence: origin cannot be verified"]
B -- "LocalSourceBuild" --> C{"Matching LocalBuildEnrollmentV1?"}
C -- "NotEnrolled" --> E1["EnrollmentRequired: user may explicitly request managed-local enrollment"]
E1 --> E2["Core commits bounded provenance and whole-bundle artifact request"]
E2 --> E3["Bootstrap helper prepares stable helper launcher journal selector and initial immutable slot"]
E3 --> E4["EnrollmentPreparedV1: restart explicitly through stable launcher before rechecking eligibility"]
C -- "Mismatched" --> U3["Unsupported before approval and quiescence: enrollment identity mismatch"]
C -- "Enrolled" --> D{"Managed-local runtime guarantees pass?"}
D -- "No" --> U4["Unsupported before quiescence with exact deterministic reason"]
D -- "Yes" --> S["Supported ManagedLocalBuildProfileV1"]

D -. "checks" .-> D1["Per-user ownership and no elevation"]
D -. "checks" .-> D2["Stable helper launcher and journal outside swapped slots"]
D -. "checks" .-> D3["Active candidate and previous whole-bundle hashes verify"]
D -. "checks" .-> D4["One durable local volume and atomic selector"]
D -. "checks" .-> D5["Complete process-tree cleanup and verification-only launch"]
D -. "checks" .-> D6["Backward-compatible or deferred data migration"]

S --> P["User may approve Activate and restart"]
P --> R["Helper revalidates the capability generation before quiescence"]
R --> Q{"Still Supported?"}
Q -- "No" --> U5["Unsupported receipt; current build remains active"]
Q -- "Yes" --> X["Atomic switch watchdog focused verification and rollback contract"]

N1["Direct cargo run cargo tauri dev mutable target output"] --> E1
E4 --> A
N2["Path name missing signature environment variable or editable setting"] --> N3["Never upgrades eligibility"]
N4["OS observations"] --> N5["May downgrade but never upgrade build origin or eligibility"]
N6["Integrity strength"] --> N7["Same-user hash and ownership; not publisher authentication"]

data.title: V1 managed-local build provenance, enrollment, and activation capability matrix
